# Paper 7: DQN (2013)

*Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning* · Module 3 — Reinforcement learning and generative modeling · [Track on the site](https://arubad.github.io/AI_Research_Journey/#paper-7)

## Walkthrough videos
- ▶ [Yannic Kilcher DQN Walkthrough](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rFwQDDbYTm4)

## Study approach
The deadly triad (function approximation, bootstrapping, off-policy). Why experience replay breaks temporal correlation and why a target network stabilizes moving Bellman targets.

## Break-it experiments
1. **HAND** — 100-line DQN on `CartPole-v1`; set replay buffer = batch_size, or update the target net every step — Q-values diverge.
   - Code: `experiments/exp1_100_line_dqn_on_set_replay_buffe.ipynb`
2. **HAND→AGENT** — Frame-stacking ablation.
   - Code: `experiments/exp2_frame_stacking_ablation.ipynb`
